Know the space.
Before you arrive.

3D walkthroughs for spaces people want to understand before they visit. We capture for companies, or independent operators join, pay to use Veylet, and deliver tours for their own clients.

Request a walkthrough ↗Become a capture partner ↓

Walkthrough pilots by agreement. Operators apply, get assessed, then pay to use the app and system.

SPACES, BETTER UNDERSTOOD

More than a view.
A feel for the space.

A walkthrough is intended to help people understand how rooms connect, revisit the details and arrive with better questions.

HOMES & PROPERTY

Bring the space to the buyer.

Help local and overseas buyers understand room connections alongside listing photos and inspections. Homeowners can also share their own space privately with family.

CLINICS & VISITOR SPACES

A familiar view before a first visit.

Propose a preview of reception, waiting areas or agreed public-facing spaces. Plan a controlled capture with no patients, personal records or private screens in view.

HOSPITALITY & VENUES

Let the visit begin online.

Introduce a stay, venue or event space to prospective guests and organisers. Confirm the specific rooms and areas represented before the tour is shared.

SHOWROOMS, INTERIORS & INSTALLATIONS

Give the project more context.

Show a display, completed installation or existing interior to clients and remote collaborators. A visual showcase supports a conversation; it is not a measured survey, BIM model or installation specification.

These are proposed uses for assessment, not proof of completed work in every sector. Each scope is quoted individually; residential pilot examples are not universal prices. Space suitability, privacy, capture quality and public delivery are confirmed before a job is agreed.

QUALIFIED CAPTURE PARTNERS

Use Veylet for your clients.

Independent photographers and capture professionals join Veylet, pay to use the app and system, and deliver 3D walkthroughs for their own clients. You keep the client relationship. We provide the app, processing and review.

Apply to use Veylet ↗

Free to apply. Assessment first. After approval you pay to use the app and system. No leads or earnings promise.

01

Tell us how you work.

Share your experience, service area, portfolio and exact phone or equipment model, including its operating system.

02

Check the capture setup.

The native pilot needs a suitable LiDAR-equipped iPhone or iPad on iOS/iPadOS 17 or later. We assess the exact model, app build and capture capabilities; a camera or ordinary listing photos alone are not sufficient.

03

Prove the practice capture.

Complete a permissioned room and doorway exercise. We review coverage, tracking, privacy and the resulting walkthrough before deciding on approval.

04

Grow through reviewed work.

Approved partners receive capture guidance and quality feedback within the agreed service. Coaching supports better delivery; approval does not promise leads, earnings or an independent certification.

Assessment currently begins by email. The hosted partner application is being prepared; this page does not create an account or grant app access.

FROM SPACE TO WALKTHROUGH

One clear process.
People at every step.

We can manage a space capture, or work with an approved partner delivering for their client. The review standard stays the same.

  1. 01

    Agree the space brief.

    Confirm permission, the rooms to include, the audience and the capture route. Scope, price and timing are agreed before work starts.

  2. 02

    Capture, then inspect.

    Veylet or an approved partner captures the agreed space. Processing and review check how the rooms connect, navigation and private details. Corrections come before release.

  3. 03

    Approve the handover.

    The authorised client reviews the exact tour. Agree the share link, access and hosting term before it goes to clients or overseas viewers.

  4. 04

    Keep the next step clear.

    The proposed service includes three months of hosting, with optional extension. End sharing or request help through an agreed support route. Paid delivery and hosting terms are confirmed in the quote.

ANSWERS

Before you apply

How do I become a capture operator?

Apply on this site. We assess your exact device, software and a practice capture before approval. After approval you pay to use the app and system. We do not promise jobs, leads or earnings.

Can I get a walkthrough without the capture app?

Yes. Request a walkthrough. Managed clients do not need Veylet Capture installed.

Does applying create an account or take payment?

No. This public site is an enquiry and assessment route. There is no live public registration or checkout.

CURRENT AVAILABILITY

Selected pilots and partner assessment. Veylet Capture and the review workspace are in local validation. Real-space quality and hosted delivery are being verified before a wider rollout. This public site is an introduction and enquiry route, with no live account registration or payment.
